entries.en: The invitation says casual clothes are fine for the picnic.
entries.zh: 邀请函上说，穿便装参加野餐就可以。

entries.en: Our chemistry textbook uses the symbol Na for sodium.
entries.zh: 我们的化学课本用符号Na表示钠。

entries.en: The clicking noise persisted even after we cleaned the fan.
entries.zh: 即使我们清理了风扇，咔哒声仍然持续着。

entries.en: Maya inherited a wooden writing desk from her grandfather.
entries.zh: 玛雅从祖父那里继承了一张木书桌。

entries.en: The program can extract dates from a folder of scanned letters.
entries.zh: 这个程序能从一个文件夹里的扫描信件中提取日期。

entries.en: A strand of wet hair stuck to his forehead.
entries.zh: 一缕湿发贴在他的额头上。

entries.en: Volunteers helped rebuild the footbridge after the flood.
entries.zh: 洪水过后，志愿者们帮助重建了人行桥。

entries.en: This blanket is woven from wool produced on a nearby farm.
entries.zh: 这条毯子是用附近农场出产的羊毛织成的。

entries.en: The tennis ball bounced over the garden fence.
entries.zh: 网球弹过了花园的栅栏。

entries.en: We pushed our bicycles up the steep lane to the cottage.
entries.zh: 我们推着自行车，沿陡峭的小路上到那间小屋。

entries.en: I heard a click as the cupboard door closed.
entries.zh: 橱柜门关上时，我听见一声咔哒响。

entries.en: Insert the blue tab into the narrow slot on the lid.
entries.zh: 把蓝色凸片插入盖子上的窄槽。

entries.en: She shared the glory of the victory with her whole team.
entries.zh: 她与全队分享了胜利的荣耀。

entries.en: The nearest exit is beside the ticket counter.
entries.zh: 最近的出口在售票柜台旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 把时间或精力投入某事
entries.en: He dedicates one evening a week to teaching adults to read.
entries.zh: 他每周拿出一个晚上教成年人识字。

entries.en: The lecture became dull when the speaker simply read every slide.
entries.zh: 演讲者开始逐张照读幻灯片后，讲座变得乏味了。

entries.en: My uncle can carve small birds from pieces of driftwood.
entries.zh: 我叔叔能用一块块浮木雕出小鸟。

entries.en: It is a pity that the exhibition closes before your visit.
entries.zh: 很遗憾，展览在你来之前就结束了。

entries.en: A partial view of the lake was visible between the trees.
entries.zh: 透过树木的间隙可以看到一部分湖面。

entries.en: The cat rolled onto its back and showed us its white belly.
entries.zh: 猫翻身仰躺，向我们露出白肚皮。

entries.en: I found a packet of seeds inside the gardening magazine.
entries.zh: 我在园艺杂志里发现了一小包种子。

entries.en: The designer conceived a folding table for tiny kitchens.
entries.zh: 设计师构想出了一款适合小厨房的折叠桌。

entries.en: The sudden bang scared the birds away from the feeder.
entries.zh: 突如其来的巨响把鸟从喂食器旁吓跑了。

entries.en: A skilled carpenter repaired the damaged staircase.
entries.zh: 一位技艺熟练的木匠修好了受损的楼梯。

entries.en: A local restaurant will cater for the school's anniversary dinner.
entries.zh: 一家本地餐馆将为学校的周年晚宴提供餐饮服务。

entries.en: The airport shuttle stops outside our hotel every half hour.
entries.zh: 机场班车每半小时在我们酒店外停靠一次。

entries.en: The thin fishing line was almost invisible against the water.
entries.zh: 那根细鱼线在水面映衬下几乎看不见。

entries.en: They announced their engagement during a quiet family dinner.
entries.zh: 他们在一次安静的家庭晚餐上宣布了订婚的消息。

entries.en: The muddy water reached just above my ankle.
entries.zh: 泥水刚刚没过我的脚踝。

entries.en: The rooftop terrace has a marvellous view of the harbour.
entries.zh: 屋顶露台能看到极美的港口景色。

entries.en: We agreed to meet under the station clock at noon.
entries.zh: 我们约好正午在车站的大钟下面见面。

entries.en: Nina made a tiny scarf for her favourite doll.
entries.zh: 妮娜给她最喜欢的娃娃做了一条小围巾。

entries.en: The museum offers an intensive weekend course in pottery.
entries.zh: 博物馆开设了一门周末陶艺强化课程。

entries.en: The worksheet asks us to identify a carbohydrate in each sample.
entries.zh: 练习单要求我们辨认每份样品中的一种碳水化合物。

entries.meaningZh: 查明疾病或故障的原因
entries.en: The technician diagnosed the fault by checking each cable in turn.
entries.zh: 技术员依次检查每根电缆，查明了故障原因。

entries.en: We envisage a garden where neighbours can grow vegetables together.
entries.zh: 我们设想建一个能让邻居们一起种菜的花园。

entries.en: A bright yellow poster advertised the school concert.
entries.zh: 一张亮黄色的海报宣传着学校音乐会。

entries.en: A beetle crawled slowly across the open notebook.
entries.zh: 一只甲虫慢慢爬过摊开的笔记本。

entries.en: Her grandfather looks handsome in the old graduation photograph.
entries.zh: 那张旧毕业照里的爷爷十分英俊。

entries.en: My tutor asked me to explain each step of the calculation.
entries.zh: 我的辅导老师让我解释计算的每一步。

entries.en: My first instinct was to hold the door for the person behind me.
entries.zh: 我的第一反应是替身后的人扶住门。

entries.en: The towels were still damp when we packed them.
entries.zh: 我们收拾行李时，毛巾仍有点湿。

entries.en: An anonymous donor paid for the library's new reading chairs.
entries.zh: 一位匿名捐赠者出资购买了图书馆的新阅览椅。

entries.en: An eagle circled above the valley on broad wings.
entries.zh: 一只鹰展开宽阔的翅膀，在山谷上空盘旋。

entries.en: Our preliminary results suggest that the new packaging uses less paper.
entries.zh: 我们的初步结果表明，新包装使用的纸更少。

entries.en: We stayed at a riverside inn with only six guest rooms.
entries.zh: 我们住在一家只有六间客房的河边小旅馆。

entries.en: Draw a vertical line through the centre of the circle.
entries.zh: 画一条穿过圆心的垂直线。

entries.en: His sister greeted him with a hug at the station.
entries.zh: 他姐姐在车站用一个拥抱迎接他。

entries.en: The ambulance turned into the hospital entrance with its lights flashing.
entries.zh: 救护车闪着灯驶入了医院入口。

entries.en: The cafe put two small tables on the pavement outside.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆在外面的人行道上摆了两张小桌子。

entries.en: The coach would not punish the whole team for one player's mistake.
entries.zh: 教练不会因为一名队员的失误惩罚全队。

entries.en: A clear glass sphere stood on a wooden base.
entries.zh: 一个透明玻璃球立在木制底座上。

entries.en: A pair of swallows built a nest above the garage door.
entries.zh: 一对燕子在车库门上方筑了巢。

entries.en: The guide described how the palace changed during the queen's reign.
entries.zh: 导游讲述了女王在位期间宫殿发生的变化。

entries.en: Her influential essay changed the way our class discussed public parks.
entries.zh: 她那篇有影响力的文章改变了我们班讨论公共公园的方式。

entries.en: Children gathered around the bronze statue of a sleeping bear.
entries.zh: 孩子们围在一尊熟睡熊的青铜雕像旁。

entries.en: His pursuit of a quieter life brought him to this coastal village.
entries.zh: 对更宁静生活的追求使他来到了这个海边村庄。

entries.en: The greenhouse contains tropical plants with enormous leaves.
entries.zh: 温室里有长着巨大叶片的热带植物。

entries.en: The database treats each branch of the library as a separate entity.
entries.zh: 数据库将图书馆的每个分馆视为一个独立实体。

entries.en: The gym is busiest just after the offices close.
entries.zh: 健身房在各办公室下班后最热闹。

entries.meaningZh: 不必要的重复或多余部分
entries.en: Removing repeated sentences reduced the redundancy in the report.
entries.zh: 删去重复的句子减少了报告中的冗余。

entries.en: The toddler held a smooth pebble tightly in her fist.
entries.zh: 小女孩把一颗光滑的鹅卵石紧紧攥在拳头里。

entries.en: She patted the dog's back before opening the gate.
entries.zh: 她打开院门前轻轻拍了拍狗的背。

entries.en: Our final destination was a campsite beside a mountain lake.
entries.zh: 我们的最终目的地是山间湖畔的一处营地。

entries.en: The student council voted to endorse the plan for longer library hours.
entries.zh: 学生会投票支持延长图书馆开放时间的计划。

entries.en: Please update the timetable when the new room numbers arrive.
entries.zh: 收到新的教室编号后，请更新课表。

entries.en: He carried three cups of tea on a wooden tray.
entries.zh: 他用一个木托盘端着三杯茶。

entries.en: Her thesis examines how small towns share water during dry seasons.
entries.zh: 她的学位论文研究小城镇如何在旱季共享水资源。

entries.en: The designer used our feedback to make the buttons easier to find.
entries.zh: 设计师根据我们的反馈，让按钮更容易找到。

entries.en: The textbook compares the institutions of a commonwealth and a monarchy.
entries.zh: 课本比较了共和国与君主国的制度。

entries.en: A purple ribbon marked the page she wanted to read aloud.
entries.zh: 一条紫色丝带标出了她想朗读的那一页。

entries.en: Afternoon sunlight fell across the kitchen floor.
entries.zh: 午后的阳光洒在厨房地板上。

entries.en: The workshop uses a laser to cut patterns into thin sheets of wood.
entries.zh: 工坊用激光器在薄木板上切割出图案。

entries.en: The bus was practically empty by the time we reached the coast.
entries.zh: 我们到达海边时，公共汽车几乎已经空了。

entries.en: The company opened a subsidiary to manage its bicycle rental service.
entries.zh: 这家公司设立了一家子公司来管理自行车租赁业务。

entries.en: We watched the parade from a balcony above the bakery.
entries.zh: 我们在面包店楼上的阳台观看了游行。

entries.en: Under the microscope, the tiny organism moved towards the light.
entries.zh: 在显微镜下，那个微小的生物体向光亮处移动。

entries.en: The discussion moved from practical design into the realm of imagination.
entries.zh: 讨论从实际设计转入了想象的领域。

entries.en: Blend the two paint colours until no streaks remain.
entries.zh: 将这两种颜料混合，直到不再有条纹。

entries.en: The therapist's office had two armchairs and a small round table.
entries.zh: 治疗师的办公室里有两把扶手椅和一张小圆桌。

entries.en: Each scholarship recipient received a letter from the university.
entries.zh: 每位奖学金获得者都收到了大学的来信。

entries.en: I peeled the orange over a bowl to catch the juice.
entries.zh: 我在碗上方剥橙子，以便接住果汁。

entries.en: Flip the pancake when bubbles appear on its surface.
entries.zh: 煎饼表面出现气泡时，把它翻面。

entries.en: The survey included several neighbourhoods to reduce bias in the results.
entries.zh: 这次调查涵盖了几个街区，以减少结果的偏差。

entries.en: She hid her disappointment when the train trip was cancelled.
entries.zh: 火车旅行被取消时，她掩饰了自己的失望。

entries.en: The poet uses a locked gate as a metaphor for fear.
entries.zh: 诗人用一道锁着的门来隐喻恐惧。

entries.en: The candle flickered whenever someone opened the dining room door.
entries.zh: 每当有人打开餐厅门，烛光就会摇曳。

entries.en: The choir sang her favourite song as a tribute to their retiring teacher.
entries.zh: 合唱团唱了老师最喜欢的歌，向即将退休的她致敬。

entries.en: Fold the paper into a diamond before making the next crease.
entries.zh: 在折下一道折痕前，先把纸折成菱形。

entries.en: We planned deliveries together to minimize the number of van journeys.
entries.zh: 我们统一安排送货，以尽量减少货车的出行次数。

entries.en: A new bookshop has opened in our neighbourhood.
entries.zh: 我们街区新开了一家书店。

entries.en: He rested his chin on his hand while listening to the story.
entries.zh: 听故事时，他用手托着下巴。

entries.en: Their apartment has a balcony, but ours has a larger kitchen.
entries.zh: 他们的公寓有阳台，而我们的公寓厨房更大。

entries.en: The path vanished beneath a thick layer of autumn leaves.
entries.zh: 小路消失在厚厚的秋叶之下。

entries.en: I must confess that I forgot to bring the tickets.
entries.zh: 我得坦白，我忘了带票。

entries.en: They are contemplating a move to a smaller house near the station.
entries.zh: 他们正考虑搬到车站附近一间更小的房子。

entries.en: Excessive decoration made the small room feel crowded.
entries.zh: 过多的装饰让小房间显得拥挤。

entries.en: The mechanic traced the clicking sound to the starter.
entries.zh: 修理工查明咔哒声来自启动机。

entries.en: The castle looked splendid in the early evening light.
entries.zh: 城堡在傍晚的光线下显得十分壮丽。

entries.en: We ate half the bread and froze the remainder.
entries.zh: 我们吃了一半面包，把剩下的冷冻起来。

entries.en: The classroom model showed how gravity pulls the ball down the ramp.
entries.zh: 课堂模型展示了重力如何把球沿斜坡向下拉。

entries.en: The teacher intervened before the disagreement disrupted the lesson.
entries.zh: 在争执影响上课之前，老师介入了调解。

entries.en: The sound of the train diminished as it entered the tunnel.
entries.zh: 火车进入隧道时，声音渐渐减弱了。

entries.en: The potter pressed her thumb into the soft clay.
entries.zh: 陶艺师把拇指按进柔软的黏土里。

entries.en: My intent was to clarify the schedule, not to add more work.
entries.zh: 我的目的是把日程说清楚，而不是增加工作。

entries.en: The new rail line links the outer suburbs with the metropolitan centre.
entries.zh: 新铁路线把远郊与大都市中心连接起来。

entries.en: The thief left the bicycle behind when its alarm sounded.
entries.zh: 自行车警报响起时，小偷丢下车逃走了。

entries.en: We had a productive morning and finished the first draft before lunch.
entries.zh: 我们上午效率很高，午饭前就完成了初稿。

entries.en: In geography class, we traced the river from its source to the sea.
entries.zh: 地理课上，我们沿着河流从源头一直追踪到入海口。

entries.en: The librarian checked the inventory before ordering more headphones.
entries.zh: 图书管理员在订购更多耳机前核对了库存清单。

entries.meaningZh: 市民事务的；城市公共事务的
entries.en: The class visited the civic centre to learn how local services are organised.
entries.zh: 全班参观了市政中心，了解地方公共服务如何组织。

entries.en: Her exceptional memory for faces helped her welcome returning guests.
entries.zh: 她记人脸的能力格外出色，这帮助她接待再次来访的客人。

entries.en: We descended the stone steps to a sheltered beach.
entries.zh: 我们沿石阶下行，来到一片避风的海滩。

entries.en: A simple diagram helped me grasp how the gears fit together.
entries.zh: 一张简单的示意图帮助我理解了齿轮如何咬合。

entries.en: The students used the woodworking tools under the teacher's supervision.
entries.zh: 学生们在老师的指导下使用木工工具。

entries.en: The strict silence of the reading room felt alien to the lively children.
entries.zh: 阅览室里严格的安静要求让活泼的孩子们感到很不习惯。

entries.en: The recipe calls for half a pint of vegetable stock.
entries.zh: 食谱需要半品脱蔬菜高汤。

entries.en: A dynamic new director brought more experimental plays to the theatre.
entries.zh: 一位充满活力的新导演为剧院带来了更多实验戏剧。

entries.en: The English translation preserves the gentle humour of the original story.
entries.zh: 英文译文保留了原故事温和的幽默。

entries.en: The child clung to his father's coat in the crowded station.
entries.zh: 在拥挤的车站里，孩子紧紧抓着父亲的外套。

entries.en: Fresh flowers lay beside the memorial in the village square.
entries.zh: 村广场的纪念碑旁放着鲜花。

entries.en: Her interest in photography began with pictures of insects in the garden.
entries.zh: 她对摄影的兴趣始于拍摄花园里的昆虫。

entries.en: The competition rules prohibit entries made by professional designers.
entries.zh: 比赛规则禁止专业设计师提交作品。

entries.en: The upstairs room is used exclusively for music lessons.
entries.zh: 楼上的房间专门用来上音乐课。

entries.en: A tall screen concealed the boxes behind the stage.
entries.zh: 一面高屏风遮住了舞台后面的箱子。

entries.en: Attendance at the introductory workshop is compulsory for new volunteers.
entries.zh: 新志愿者必须参加入门工作坊。

entries.en: The strongest similarity between the two houses is their circular staircase.
entries.zh: 这两栋房子最明显的相似之处是它们的旋转楼梯。

entries.en: The artist drew a strong jaw beneath the man's narrow face.
entries.zh: 画家在那张瘦长的脸下画出了轮廓分明的下颌。

entries.en: I stumbled over a loose paving stone outside the shop.
entries.zh: 我在商店外被一块松动的铺路石绊了一下。

entries.en: The hikers followed the ridge until they could see the lake below.
entries.zh: 徒步者沿着山脊前进，直到能看见下方的湖。

entries.en: At dawn, the fishing boats began to leave the harbour.
entries.zh: 黎明时，渔船开始驶离港口。

entries.en: The museum's oldest automobile has wooden wheels and brass lamps.
entries.zh: 博物馆里最古老的汽车装着木轮和黄铜车灯。

entries.en: The biology model shows the liver beneath the ribs.
entries.zh: 这个生物模型展示了肋骨下方的肝脏。

entries.en: The photographs show the progressive restoration of the old station.
entries.zh: 这些照片展示了老车站逐步修复的过程。

entries.en: Our flight departs from the smaller terminal across the road.
entries.zh: 我们的航班从马路对面较小的航站楼出发。

entries.en: Changing the delivery address at this stage may incur an extra charge.
entries.zh: 在这个阶段更改送货地址可能会产生额外费用。

entries.en: The travel diary describes a month-long journey through continental Europe.
entries.zh: 这本旅行日记描述了一次为期一个月的欧洲大陆之旅。

entries.en: We shared a cab home after the last bus had left.
entries.zh: 末班公交车开走后，我们合乘出租车回家。

entries.en: She borrowed a historical romance set in a busy port city.
entries.zh: 她借了一本以繁忙港口城市为背景的历史爱情小说。

entries.en: I tucked the folded blanket under my pillow before leaving the room.
entries.zh: 离开房间前，我把折好的毯子塞在枕头下面。

entries.en: The exhibition includes primitive tools made from sharpened stone.
entries.zh: 展览包括用磨尖的石头制成的原始工具。

entries.en: The sculptor chose bronze because it would suit the outdoor setting.
entries.zh: 雕塑家选择了青铜，因为它适合户外环境。

entries.en: The orchestra tuned its instruments while the audience found their seats.
entries.zh: 观众寻找座位时，管弦乐队正在调音。

entries.en: I have been walking to campus more often lately.
entries.zh: 我最近更常步行去学校。

entries.en: There was scarcely enough room for both suitcases in the boot.
entries.zh: 后备箱几乎放不下这两个行李箱。

entries.en: She scanned the noticeboard for news of the postponed match.
entries.zh: 她快速浏览公告栏，寻找延期比赛的消息。

entries.en: The restored fountain should be operational by the opening ceremony.
entries.zh: 修复后的喷泉应该能在开幕式时正常运作。

entries.en: The manager gave us verbal instructions before sending the written plan.
entries.zh: 经理先给我们口头指示，随后才发来书面计划。

entries.en: The course compares different interpretations of socialism in twentieth-century writing.
entries.zh: 这门课程比较二十世纪著作中对社会主义的不同解读。

entries.en: The exclusion of weekend trips made the travel estimate unusually low.
entries.zh: 由于没有包括周末出行，交通费用估算低得不寻常。

entries.en: The two versions are substantially the same, apart from the headings.
entries.zh: 除了标题，这两个版本大体相同。

entries.en: A systematic search of every drawer finally uncovered the missing key.
entries.zh: 对每个抽屉进行有条理的搜寻后，我们终于找到了丢失的钥匙。

entries.en: The diagram labels each constituent of the mixture with a different colour.
entries.zh: 这张图用不同颜色标出了混合物的各个组成部分。

entries.en: Her farewell speech expressed a sentiment that everyone in the room shared.
entries.zh: 她的告别演讲表达了在场所有人共同的感受。

entries.en: The poem imagines a traveller receiving divine guidance in a dream.
entries.zh: 这首诗想象了一位旅人在梦中得到神的指引。

entries.en: Please pardon the noise while we move these chairs upstairs.
entries.zh: 我们把这些椅子搬上楼时会有些噪声，请谅解。

entries.en: We loaded the folded chairs onto a cart and wheeled them outside.
entries.zh: 我们把折叠椅装上小推车，推到了外面。

entries.en: An experienced librarian will oversee the move to the new building.
entries.zh: 一位经验丰富的图书管理员将负责搬迁到新馆的工作。

entries.en: My elder brother taught me how to repair a bicycle puncture.
entries.zh: 我哥哥教过我如何修补自行车轮胎的破洞。

entries.en: The historian examined the ideological differences between the two movements.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了这两个运动在意识形态上的差异。

entries.en: Everyone called her a musical genius after hearing her first composition.
entries.zh: 听了她的第一首作品后，大家都称她是音乐天才。

entries.en: The stone monument lists the names of the bridge's builders.
entries.zh: 石碑上列着建桥者的姓名。

entries.en: His quest for the perfect photograph led him back to the same hill each winter.
entries.zh: 为了寻求那张完美的照片，他每年冬天都会重返同一座山。

entries.en: I treasure the handwritten recipe my grandmother gave me.
entries.zh: 我珍藏着祖母送给我的手写食谱。

entries.en: An unfortunate delay meant that we missed the final ferry.
entries.zh: 一次令人遗憾的延误使我们错过了最后一班渡轮。

entries.en: Students can move freely between the reading area and the courtyard.
entries.zh: 学生可以在阅览区和庭院之间自由走动。

entries.en: Fortunately, someone had handed my lost wallet to the station staff.
entries.zh: 幸运的是，有人把我丢失的钱包交给了车站工作人员。

entries.en: Each nominee for the award will present a short film at the festival.
entries.zh: 每位奖项提名者都将在电影节上展示一部短片。

entries.en: The old lawnmower runs on gasoline rather than electricity.
entries.zh: 那台旧割草机使用汽油，而不是电。

entries.en: The new canvas bag was too stiff to fold flat.
entries.zh: 新帆布包太硬，无法折平。

entries.en: He slapped the table in delight when the winning number was read out.
entries.zh: 中奖号码被念出来时，他高兴地拍了一下桌子。

entries.en: The narrow path curved upwards towards a ruined tower.
entries.zh: 狭窄的小路向上弯向一座残破的塔。

entries.en: The supermarket now has a shelf for produce from local farms.
entries.zh: 这家超市现在设有一个货架，专卖本地农场的农产品。

entries.en: The idea that every quiet student is bored is nonsense.
entries.zh: 认为所有安静的学生都感到无聊，这种说法毫无道理。

entries.en: She chose the history of diabetes research as the topic for her presentation.
entries.zh: 她选择糖尿病研究史作为报告主题。

entries.en: The fictional factory in the novel releases toxic waste into the river.
entries.zh: 小说中那家虚构的工厂向河里排放有毒废物。

entries.en: He found it difficult to describe his grief after losing his oldest friend.
entries.zh: 失去自己交情最久的朋友后，他发现很难形容自己的悲痛。

entries.en: A mysterious light appeared in the empty tower every evening.
entries.zh: 每天傍晚，空塔里都会出现一道神秘的亮光。

entries.en: Nowadays, I keep my shopping list on my phone.
entries.zh: 如今，我把购物清单记在手机上。

entries.en: The hotel donated its spare blankets to the community shelter.
entries.zh: 酒店把多余的毯子捐给了社区收容所。

entries.en: An awkward silence followed when neither guest could remember the other's name.
entries.zh: 两位客人都想不起对方的名字，接着是一阵尴尬的沉默。

entries.en: Our cat invariably chooses the warmest chair in the room.
entries.zh: 我们的猫总是选择房间里最暖和的椅子。

entries.en: She accepted the disappointing result with quiet dignity.
entries.zh: 她平静而有尊严地接受了令人失望的结果。

entries.en: The studio has a separate bin to dispose of scraps of paper.
entries.zh: 工作室设有一个单独的垃圾桶来处理废纸片。

entries.en: She spoke about her former teachers with obvious affection.
entries.zh: 她谈起以前的老师时，流露出明显的喜爱之情。

entries.en: A single bubble rose from the bottom of the clear glass vase.
entries.zh: 一个气泡从透明玻璃花瓶的底部升起。

entries.en: The dancer crossed the stage with effortless grace.
entries.zh: 舞者轻盈优雅地穿过舞台。

entries.meaningZh: 存放谷物或农具的农舍
entries.en: The farmer stored the hay in the dry upper floor of the barn.
entries.zh: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓干燥的上层。

entries.en: The sugar dissolved as she stirred the warm tea.
entries.zh: 她搅动温茶时，糖溶解了。

entries.en: The story challenges prejudice against people with unfamiliar accents.
entries.zh: 这个故事质疑了人们对陌生口音者的偏见。

entries.en: He used his hat to shield the camera from the falling snow.
entries.zh: 他用帽子挡住飘落的雪，保护相机。

entries.en: The paintings arrived in protective cases lined with soft foam.
entries.zh: 这些画装在内衬软泡沫的保护箱中运到了。

entries.en: Tuck the loose end of the scarf inside your coat.
entries.zh: 把围巾松散的一端塞进外套里。

entries.en: The forthcoming exhibition will feature photographs taken by local teenagers.
entries.zh: 即将举办的展览将展出本地青少年拍摄的照片。

entries.en: Both concerts are on Friday, leaving us with a pleasant dilemma.
entries.zh: 两场音乐会都在周五，这让我们陷入了甜蜜的两难。

entries.en: A thick hedge separates the playground from the road.
entries.zh: 一道茂密的树篱把游乐场与马路隔开。

entries.en: The old door handle is made of brass polished smooth by many hands.
entries.zh: 旧门把手由黄铜制成，被许多双手磨得光滑。

entries.en: The chair remained neutral while the two groups explained their proposals.
entries.zh: 两组阐述各自方案时，主持人保持了中立。

entries.en: The ducks gathered in a shallow pool beside the bridge.
entries.zh: 鸭子聚集在桥旁的浅水池里。

entries.en: Follow the green arrow to reach the exhibition entrance.
entries.zh: 沿着绿色箭头指示的方向走，就能到达展览入口。
